services.name: Zip Line Adventure
services.desc: Guided 2.5-hour adventure with six ziplines, a 100-foot suspension bridge, off-roading in 4x4 UTVs, and hiking along Moab’s red rock fins. Ages 6+ • Approx. 2.5 Hours • Must Be At Least 42" in Height & Weight Between 50-275 lbs.

services.name: Sunset Zip Line Tour
services.desc: A sunset adventure combining six zip lines, a 100-foot suspension bridge, 4x4 off-roading and sunset views. Ages 6+ • 3 Hours • Must Be At Least 42" in Height & Weight Between 50-275 lbs.

services.name: You-Drive Hell's Revenge UTV Adventure
services.desc: A guided UTV journey across Hell's Revenge trail to Raven's Rim's canyon-view deck for s'mores, a fire, and one of Moab's most unforgettable sunsets. Ends with smore's at our private sunset deck

includes: You-Drive Hell's Revenge UTV Adventure: up to 4 guests per booking.
blurb: Guests experience zipline tours over Moab's red rock terrain with expert guides emphasizing safety and hospitality. Tours include a 2 mile off-road trail to 6 ziplines ranging from mild to wild, a sunset zipline tour, and a challenge course with highlines and space nets. The experience includes breathtaking views and relaxing moments around a fire with s'mores at sunset.
